claim_boundary: Basic-block formula targets are PROVISIONAL_EXPERT_REVIEW, not industrial pattern truth.

GarmentCode coordinate calibration is fitted on training IDs only and transfers residual distributions with one isotropic scale per query; path and construction-line endpoints remain exact and it does not repair source geometry sample by sample.
Only the training partition is deterministically category-oversampled; validation and test retain the natural 37/138/342 source imbalance.
The visual test is same-generator, same-render-style, same-neutral-body sample-ID unseen; it is not family-disjoint or cross-domain.
The student receives four-view features only at inference; vector patterns are used only by the frozen training teacher.
No original source image is written to metrics, predictions, or checkpoints.
